description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware on a device, including a check image function and an upgrade procedure that defaults to a generic upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image (returns success by default).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, delegating to a default method for unspecified boards.
